title: Window functions: ranking without losing the rows

steps.title: ROW_NUMBER over a window
steps.prompt:
So far every row kept its own facts. A window function looks at a WINDOW of rows around each row and computes with them - like a medal table.
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) numbers rows from the most expensive down.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT name, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS pos FROM products LIMIT 5;
hints: Pick name, price, and the ranking column.
steps.expected_sql: SELECT name, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS pos FROM products LIMIT 5;

steps.title: Fill the function with the sharers
steps.task: Fill the blank with the sharing-rank function.
hints: ROW_NUMBER never shares - this one does.
steps.expected_sql: SELECT name, price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS r FROM products LIMIT 5;
steps.seed_sql: SELECT name, price, ___() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS r FROM products LIMIT 5;
steps.memory_trick: RANK shares ties; ROW_NUMBER breaks them arbitrarily.

steps.title: Why 'window'?
steps.prompt:
There's a third famous one: DENSE_RANK() - ties share, and numbering never skips.
These are called WINDOW functions because each row looks at the window of rows around it (sorted), not just itself.
steps.task: What sorts the window in the OVER clause?
hints: The window slides across sorted rows.
steps.memory_trick: OVER (ORDER BY …) = slide across this order.
